definitions.explanation: A product made on a trial basis before mass production. Used in manufacturing, technology, cooking, and other fields where items are tested before final release.

examples.japanese: {試作品|しさくひん}を{作|つく}る。
{新|あたら}しい{試作品|しさくひん}のテストが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Testing of the new prototype has begun.

examples.japanese: {試作品|しさくひん}の{段階|だんかい}では{問題|もんだい}がなかったが、{量産|りょうさん}で{不具合|ふぐあい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: There were no problems at the prototype stage, but defects appeared during mass production.

notes:
Composed of {試作|しさく} (trial manufacture) + {品|ひん} (product). Refers to an early version of a product created for evaluation and testing before committing to full production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試作品|しさくひん}を{作|つく}る: to make a prototype
- {試作品|しさくひん}のテスト: prototype testing
- {試作品|しさくひん}の{段階|だんかい}: prototype stage
- {試作品|しさくひん}を{完成|かんせい}させる: to complete a prototype

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見本|みほん}: sample — a finished product shown as a representative example, not necessarily a test version
- {模型|もけい}: model — a scaled or simplified representation, not a functional trial product
- プロトタイプ: prototype — the English loanword, used more in tech/startup contexts
